podcast: CEO Numbers Network with Danielle Hayden

19ba27f1ca.q: Why do most business budgets fail according to Danielle Hayden?
19ba27f1ca.a: Every budget that fails is built like a diet, and nobody can stick to their diet forever. When business owners build budgets by cutting back, they eliminate the tools, software, and contractors that make their business run, then take all that work back on their own shoulders. This cutting back works against every goal set as a business owner—it keeps them from pursuing growth opportunities and forces them to do everything themselves.
19ba27f1ca.e: The 2027 Budget Reset, Part 1 of 3: Start With the Right Mindset

64cbef6e05.q: What is the key mindset difference between a business owner and a CEO when building a budget?
64cbef6e05.a: A business owner asks 'what can I cut?' while a CEO asks 'where is this dollar going to move my business forward?' It can look like the same budget, but it has a completely different mindset. The second one is the mindset that's going to grow your business.
64cbef6e05.e: The 2027 Budget Reset, Part 1 of 3: Start With the Right Mindset

25ffd70b51.q: How did Danielle Hayden help a client restart business growth after 12 months of flat revenue?
25ffd70b51.a: When reviewing the client's numbers, Hayden found she was underspending in very specific categories—she had stopped investing in advertising, marketing campaigns, conferences, and speaking engagements that had driven her initial growth. By looking backwards at what had worked before, they planned to reinvest in those areas, including bringing back a PR firm. A few months into the new budget, the client reported seeing growth in her business again.
25ffd70b51.e: The 2027 Budget Reset, Part 1 of 3: Start With the Right Mindset

8f8bbf84aa.q: What should business owners examine first before creating a budget according to Danielle Hayden?
8f8bbf84aa.a: Before touching any budget plan, pull up the last 12 months of financials and ask yourself: where have I been underspending in areas that used to drive my growth? Then ask what the goal is for your business and where you want to go. You cannot build a budget without knowing where you've been.
8f8bbf84aa.e: The 2027 Budget Reset, Part 1 of 3: Start With the Right Mindset

02fa0095a0.q: What does a goal-focused budget allow business owners to prioritize according to Danielle Hayden?
02fa0095a0.a: A goal-focused budget reflects where you are and what you actually want to achieve. That might mean revenue growth, or it might mean holding steady on revenue during a season where you need to protect your energy. It might also mean finally hiring support so you get out of a role you've outgrown as a CEO. Your budget needs to reflect your actual business goals, not a generic should list.
02fa0095a0.e: The 2027 Budget Reset, Part 1 of 3: Start With the Right Mindset
